arxiv-2010-13528.title: RELATIVE HYPERBOLICITY OF GRAPHICAL SMALL CANCELLATION GROUPS Thanks: S. H. is supported by NSFC under Grant No. 11771022 and No. 11871078.
arxiv-2010-13528.creator: Suzhen Han
arxiv-2010-13528.description: Abstract . A piece of a labelled graph Γ \Gamma defined by D. Gruber is a labelled path that embeds into Γ \Gamma in two essentially different ways. We prove that graphical G ​ r ′ ​ ( 1 6 ) Gr^{\prime}(\frac{1}{6}) small cancellation groups whose associated pieces have uniformly bounded length are relative hyperbolic.

arxiv-2102-09839.title: A photometric study of two neglected eclipsing binaries
arxiv-2102-09839.creator: V. Kudak, M. Fedurco, V. Perig, Š. Parimucha
arxiv-2102-09839.description: Abstract We present the first BVR photometry, period variation, and photometric light-curve analysis of two poorly studied eclipsing binaries V1321 Cyg and CR Tau. Observations were carried out from November 2017 to January 2020 at the observatory of Uzhhorod National University. Period variations were studied using all available early published as well as our minima times.

arxiv-2106-08937.title: A Predictive Coding account for Chaotic Itinerancy Thanks: This work was funded by the CY Cergy-Paris University Foundation (Facebook grant) and partially by Labex MME-DII, France (ANR11-LBX-0023-01). Affiliation: ETIS UMR 8051, CY University, ENSEA, CNRS
arxiv-2106-08937.creator: Louis Annnabi, Alexandre Pitti, Mathias Quoy
arxiv-2106-08937.description: Abstract As a phenomenon in dynamical systems allowing autonomous switching between stable behaviors, chaotic itinerancy has gained interest in neurorobotics research. In this study, we draw a connection between this phenomenon and the predictive coding theory by showing how a recurrent neural network implementing predictive coding can generate neural trajectories similar to chaotic itinerancy in the presence of input noise.

arxiv-2112-05010.title: The Value of Robust Assortment Optimization Under Ranking-based Choice Models
arxiv-2112-05010.creator: Bradley Sturt
arxiv-2112-05010.description: Abstract We study a class of robust assortment optimization problems that was proposed by Farias, Jagabathula, and Shah (2013). The goal in these problems is to find an assortment that maximizes a firm’s worst-case expected revenue under all ranking-based choice models that are consistent with the historical sales data generated by the firm’s past assortments.

arxiv-2205-15445.title: Continual Object Detection: A review of definitions, strategies, and challenges Journal: Neural Networks
arxiv-2205-15445.creator: Angelo G. Menezes, Gustavo de Moura, Cézanne Alves, André C. P. L. F. de Carvalho
arxiv-2205-15445.description: Abstract The field of Continual Learning investigates the ability to learn consecutive tasks without losing performance on those previously learned. Its focus has been mainly on incremental classification tasks. We believe that research in continual object detection deserves even more attention due to its vast range of applications in robotics and autonomous vehicles.

arxiv-2304-06504.title: Developing a Robust Computable Phenotype Definition Workflow to Describe Health and Disease in Observational Health Research
arxiv-2304-06504.creator: 1 st Jacob S. Zelko, 2 nd Sarah Gasman, 3 rd Shenita R. Freeman, 4 th Dong Yun Lee, 5 th Jaan Altosaar, 6 th Azza Shoabi, 7 th Gowtham Rao
arxiv-2304-06504.description: Abstract Health informatics can inform decisions that practitioners, patients, policymakers, and researchers need to make about health and disease. Health informatics is built upon patient health data leading to the need to codify patient health information. Such standardization is required to compute population statistics (such as prevalence, incidence, etc.) that are common metrics used in fields such as epidemiology.

arxiv-2310-06666.title: Unlock the Potential of Counterfactually-Augmented Data in Out-Of-Distribution Generalization Journal: Expert Systems With Applications
arxiv-2310-06666.creator: Caoyun Fan, Wenqing Chen, Jidong Tian, Yitian Li, Hao He, Yaohui Jin
arxiv-2310-06666.description: Abstract Counterfactually-Augmented Data (CAD) – minimal editing of sentences to flip the corresponding labels – has the potential to improve the Out-Of-Distribution (OOD) generalization capability of language models, as CAD induces language models to exploit domain-independent causal features and exclude spurious correlations. However, the empirical results of CAD’s OOD generalization are not as efficient as anticipated.

arxiv-2409-02256.title: Inferring Cosmological Parameters on SDSS via Domain-Generalized Neural Networks and Lightcone Simulations
arxiv-2409-02256.creator: Jun-Young Lee, Ji-hoon Kim, Minyong Jung, Boon Kiat Oh, Yongseok Jo, Songyoun Park, Jaehyun Lee, Yuan-Sen Ting, Ho Seong Hwang
arxiv-2409-02256.description: Abstract We present a proof-of-concept simulation-based inference on Ω m \Omega_{\rm m} and σ 8 \sigma_{8} from the SDSS BOSS LOWZ NGC catalog using neural networks and domain generalization techniques without the need of summary statistics. Using rapid lightcone simulations, L -PICOLA , mock galaxy catalogs are produced that fully incorporate the observational effects.

arxiv-2503-05355.title: On the Logical Content of Knowledge Bases
arxiv-2503-05355.creator: Alexander V. Gheorghiu, Tao Gu
arxiv-2503-05355.description: Abstract Standard epistemic logics introduce a modal operator 𝐊 \mathbf{K} to represent knowledge, but in doing so presuppose the logical apparatus they aim to explain. By contrast, this paper explores how logic may be derived from the structure of knowledge itself.

arxiv-2503-18692.title: Clutter Tracking using Variational Message Passing Thanks: This work is funded by the Thomas B. Thriges Foundation grant 7538-1806.
arxiv-2503-18692.creator: Anders Malthe Westerkam, Troels Pedersen
arxiv-2503-18692.description: Abstract We propose a message passing algorithm for tracking of clutter signals in MIMO radar. The method exploits basis expansion to linearise the signal model, to enable mean field approach for tracking the posterior distribution of the clutter as it evolves across time, as well as the mean and precision of the clutter map.

arxiv-2510-16636.title: A three-step machine learning approach to predict market bubbles with financial news
arxiv-2510-16636.creator: Abraham Atsiwo
arxiv-2510-16636.description: Abstract . This study presents a three-step machine learning framework to predict bubbles in the S&P 500 stock market by combining financial news sentiment with macroeconomic indicators. Building on traditional econometric approaches, the proposed approach predicts bubble formation by integrating textual and quantitative data sources.

arxiv-2601-19654.title: Mercury-Opal: the GPU-accelerated version of the n-body code for planet formation Mercury-Ar χ \chi es Journal: Astronomy & \& Computing
arxiv-2601-19654.creator: Paolo Matteo Simonetti, Diego Turrini, Romolo Politi, Scigé J. Liu, Sergio Fonte, Danae Polychroni, Stavro Lambrov Ivanovski
arxiv-2601-19654.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Paolo Matteo Simonetti, Diego Turrini, Romolo Politi, Scigé J. Liu, Sergio Fonte, Danae Polychroni, Stavro Lambrov Ivanovski. Large n-body simulations with fully interacting objects represent the next frontier in computational planetary formation studies. In this paper, we present Mercury-Opal , the GPU-accelerated version of the n-body planet formation code Mercury-Ar χ \chi es .

britannica-1911-fleury-andre-hercule-de.title: Fleury, André Hercule de (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-fleury-andre-hercule-de.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-fleury-andre-hercule-de.description: Article 'Fleury, André Hercule de' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 10), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. cardinal and statesman, was born at Lodève (Hérault) on the 22nd of June 1653, the son of a collector of taxes. Educated by the Jesuits in Paris, he entered the priesthood, and became in 1679, through the influence of Cardinal Bonzi, almoner to Maria Theresa, queen of Louis XIV., and in 1698 bishop of Fréjus.

britannica-1911-hastings-warren.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-hastings-warren.description: Article 'Hastings, Warren' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 13), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. of British India, was born on the 6th of December 1732 in the little hamlet of Churchill in Oxfordshire. He came of a family which had been settled for many generations in the adjoining village of Daylesford; but his great-grandfather had sold the ancestral manor-house, and his grandfather had been unable to maintain himself in possession of the family living.

pmc-10573834.title: Self-Discharge Processes in Symmetrical Supercapacitors with Activated Carbon Electrodes
pmc-10573834.creator: Alexey Yu. Rychagov, Valentin E. Sosenkin, Marianna Yu. Izmailova, Evgeny N. Kabachkov, Yury M. Shulga, Yury M. Volfkovich, Gennady L. Gutsev
pmc-10573834.description: The self-discharge of an electric double-layer capacitor with composite activated carbon electrodes and aqueous electrolyte (1 M MgSO4) was studied in detail. Under a long-term potentiostatic charge (stabilization), a decrease in the discharge capacity was observed in the region of voltages exceeding 0.8 V. The self-discharge process consists of two phases.

pmc-10674984.title: A CMOS Image Sensor Dark Current Compensation Using In-Pixel Temperature Sensors †
pmc-10674984.creator: Accel Abarca, Albert Theuwissen
pmc-10674984.description: This paper presents a novel technique for dark current compensation of a CMOS image sensor (CIS) by using in-pixel temperature sensors (IPTSs) over a temperature range from −40 °C to 90 °C. The IPTS makes use of the 4T pixel as a temperature sensor.

pmc-11403840.title: Correlation between learning styles and attitudes toward interprofessional education among medical students: a cross-sectional study
pmc-11403840.creator: Chengrui Zhang, Xinxin Wang, Ying Xing, Wei Luan, Tao Jin
pmc-11403840.description: BackgroundInterprofessional teamwork improves patient care quality, safety, and health outcomes. Interprofessional education (IPE) is crucial in today’s medical education to prepare students for the workforce as integral members of a collaborative team. The diversity of IPE learners indicates the importance of exploring the relationship between learning styles and attitudes toward IPE.

pmc-11551949.title: Mono- and Bichromophores Formed from Perylene Monoimide Diesters: Competition between Intramolecular Charge Transfer and Intermolecular Singlet Exciton Fission
pmc-11551949.creator: Demet
pmc-11551949.description: Perylene monoimide diesters and the corresponding phenyl-linked bichromophores are strongly fluorescent in dilute solution with minimal triplet population after relaxation of the initial Franck–Condon state. The monomer forms nonemissive face-to-face dimers in solution, wherein illumination leads to formation of a spin-correlated, triplet pair with a yield of ca. 13% and with a time constant of 4 ± 1 ps.

pmc-11589052.title: Postmarketing Surveillance of Full Spectrum Hemp Extract CBD Products: Reported Adverse Events and Serious Adverse Events
pmc-11589052.creator: Colleen M Kingsbury, Ivori Zvorsky, Kevin Spelman
pmc-11589052.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundThere is a growing interest in products featuring hemp extracts and a demand for more data regarding their safety. To date, there is a paucity of published data on the safety of these products.MethodsA retrospective analysis of postmarketing surveillance data collected in the United States on full spectrum hemp extract (FSHE) products manufactured by Charlotte’s Web (CW) was conducted over an 18-month period (January 2019 to July 2020).

pmc-13248416.title: Naringenin ameliorates swine pulpitis by modulating immune response
pmc-13248416.creator: Qian Wang, Wenfeng Zeng, Huilin Liang, Syngcuk Kim, Lanting Shao, Yan Yan, Yumeng Guo, Siqi Huang, Ying Zheng
pmc-13248416.description: BackgroundPreserving dental pulp vitality is crucial for maintaining the physiological function of the tooth. Naringenin (Nar), known for its immunomodulatory properties, has shown pharmacological effects on various inflammatory diseases. This study aimed to investigate the therapeutic potential of Nar in treating Porphyromonas gingivalis lipopolysaccharide (P.g-LPS)-induced pulpitis in a swine model and to elucidate the mechanisms underlying its therapeutic efficacy.

pmc-13381492.title: Topology-aware hybrid graph-transformer network for Alzheimer's disease diagnosis from structural magnetic resonance imaging
pmc-13381492.creator: Nadhmi A. Gazem, Shahid Latif, Wad Ghaban, Sultan Noman Qasem
pmc-13381492.description: IntroductionAlzheimer's disease (AD) is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder characterized by localized cortical atrophy and large-scale disruption of brain connectivity. Although deep learning (DL) methods have shown promise for neuroimaging-based diagnosis, many approaches fail to jointly capture localized structural changes and global network-level degeneration.MethodsWe propose a topology-aware hybrid DL framework for AD classification from structural MRI.

pmc-13641680.creator: Jake P. Mann, Karn Wijarnpreecha, Vitchapong Prasitsumrit, Eric Trépo, Elizabeth K. Speliotes, Vincent L. Chen
pmc-13641680.description: Chronic liver disease is a rapidly growing cause of morbidity and mortality worldwide, and this increase is largely driven by steatotic liver disease (SLD) comprising metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD), alcohol-related liver disease (ALD), and MASLD and increased alcohol intake (MetALD).
